title: Acoustic Anomaly Detection for Early Identification of Drill Jamming
abstract: arXiv:2611.07356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the context of Industry 4.0, predictive maintenance is essential to minimize unplanned downtime and ensure operational safety. In machining processes, drill jamming is a critical failure that compromises both workpiece quality and tool integrity. This work proposes an acoustic anomaly detection system using ultrasonic sensors to identify pre-failure patterns in Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machining. We release a public dataset of time- and frequency-domain acoustic features from 17 drills, and benchmark semi-supervised autoencoder-based normality modelling against supervised XGBoost classification using Leave-One-Drill-Out validation. The results demonstrate that the Autoencoder is highly effective for industrial safety, achieving a Recall of 1.00 and a consolidated F1-score of 0.81. translated_title: 用于钻头卡钻早期识别的声学异常检测
translated_abstract: 在工业4.0的背景下，预测性维护对于最大限度地减少计划外停机并确保运行安全至关重要。在机械加工过程中，钻头卡钻是一种严重故障，会同时损害工件质量和刀具完整性。这项工作提出了一种使用超声波传感器的声学异常检测系统，用于识别数控（CNC）加工中的故障前模式。我们发布了一个包含来自17个钻头的时间域和频域声学特征的公开数据集，并采用留一钻头（Leave-One-Drill-Out）验证方法，将基于半监督自编码器的正常性建模与有监督的XGBoost分类进行了基准比较。结果表明，自编码器在工业安全方面非常有效，召回率达到1.00，综合F1分数为0.81。此外，与阈值无关的分析显示，自编码器能够更好地区分正常声学模式与故障前声学模式，取得了更…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于超声波传感器的声学异常检测系统，用于数控加工中钻头卡钻的早期识别，发布了公开数据集，并证明半监督自编码器模型在故障前模式检测上优于有监督XGBoost，召回率达1.00、F1分数达0.81。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ultrasonic-based acoustic anomaly detection system for early identification of drill jamming in CNC machining, releases a public dataset of 17 drills, and demonstrates that a semi-supervised autoencoder outperforms supervised XGBoost with a Recall of 1.00 and a consolidated F1-score of 0.81.
